corrected_statement: Amend the §39 rules at line 7611 so that a close reason must name the bead's own done-when evidence (a test name, a gate-record id or a decision entry) and a generic multi-bead reason is not evidence. remaining_uncertainty: I did not exercise policy.yaml against this repository, because that would modify .beads. Regex enforcement can require a reference but cannot by itself prove the evidence is the bead's own.
decision_impact: Moderate to high: it prevents a recurrence after C036 is applied.

corrected_statement: The committed epistemic types are not the plan's. fmine-evidence `EvidenceClass` is a 5-value total order {Placeholder < Assumed < Historical < Calibrated < Exact}. §7.1 and NL-2 define eight classes under a partial order (Measured > Derived > ModelledCalibrated > {ModelledUncalibrated, Transferred, Elicited} > Assumed > Assertion). NL-2's incomparable classes, NL-5's conflicted/redacted/not_observable rules, G-EXEC (line 589) and G-DISC (line 684) therefore cannot be stated over the committed types.
